verdict.rationale: Open WebUI supports scheduled/recurring prompt automations and webhooks that notify on task completion, which cover time-based triggers and some event notification, but there's no evidence of general event-driven rule definition (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y' conditional triggers beyond scheduling or chat completion). missing for 10: conditional/event-based trigger rules beyond time schedules and webhooks, a rules engine or trigger builder, and independent/community confirmation of automation reliability.
